Conclusion
Linear Independence: Equivalent to N(A) = 0, tested by placing vectors as columns of A and checking for free variables.Spanning: Extends the definition of column space C(A) as all linear combinations of columns.Basis: Combines independence and spanning. For R^n, checking if n vectors form a basis is equivalent to testing matrix invertibility.Dimension: Bridges matrix rank r to geometry: dim(C(A)) = r and dim(N(A)) = n - r.
